title: Starlight at Gray's Crossing | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked into the scenic community of Gray’s Crossing, this thoughtfully designed mountain retreat offers the perfect balance of comfort, style, and access to year-round adventure. With three well-appointed bedrooms, an additional bunk room, and over 2,600 square feet of living space, the home invites families and friends to relax and reconnect. The open-concept main floor features a cozy great room with plush seating and a fireplace, a chef’s kitchen with premium Bosch appliances, and a spacious dining area for lively shared meals. Step outside to enjoy summer evenings on the patio, complete with a BBQ grill and private hot tub under the stars. Upstairs, the expansive Primary suite is a serene sanctuary, offering a fireplace, jetted tub, private deck, and space to work or unwind. A nearby converted bunk room doubles as a fun hangout space, perfect for younger travelers. Surrounded by miles of trails and open space, yet just minutes from downtown Truckee and Northstar Resort, this home places the best of Tahoe at your fingertips whether you're carving fresh tracks in winter or paddleboarding under the summer sun. From peaceful mornings to adventure-filled days, this Gray’s Crossing getaway is where mountain memories are made.
